sentences.text: Allegation of rape was also alleged against the applicant.
The F.I.R. in question was lodged after about four days of the alleged incident.
In the statement recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C., the victim stated that applicant along with one other person had removed the clothes of the victim and thereafter she fell unconscious.
In the said statement she also stated that there was a dispute going on in between the parties.
The medical report, prima-facie does not indicate the offence under Section 376 I.P.C., except for the allegation that the applicant lay himself on the victim.
In the statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., the victim supported the prosecution story and also stated that there was an ongoing dispute in between the parties.

The Investigating Officer in his report, which is contained as Parcha no. CD 10, highlighted that on several occasions in the past, a dispute has occurred in between the parties and allegations of almost same nature was alleged earlier also but was subsequently compromised.

Strong reliance is placed upon the statement of the father of the victim, who had stated that no such incident occurred and only on account of the dispute, the case was registered against the applicant.
It is further submitted that applicant has no criminal antecedent except the present one and he is in jail since 21.11.2020.
5. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

6. Considering the said statements, including statement of father of the victim, coupled with the fact that even as per the statement of the victim under Section 161 Cr.P.C. and the medical report,
prima-facie the allegations in the F.I.R. are not corroborated.
The ongoing litigation in between the parties is admitted in various documents.
The applicant has no criminal history of similar offence and as such the applicant who is in custody since 21.11.2020 is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Lallan Dubey @ Devendra Kumar be released on bail in Case Crime No. 791 of 2020, under Sections 376AB, 506 I.P.C. and section 5(m)/6 POCSO Act, P.S. Rasulabad,
district-Kanpur Dehat, on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 18.12.2023 Faridul  Lallan Dubey @ Devendra Kumar vs State Of U.P. And Another on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/22533689/
